setting.label: 1912 CE · Final frame at the end of the Meiji era
setting.note: The lecture distinguishes 1914 serialization from the 1912 deaths of Emperor Meiji and General Nogi that frame the final confession. The earlier betrayal occurred years before the frame.

description: Analyzes Sōseki’s Kokoro through its three-part structure and shift from student narrator to Sensei’s testament. Examines betrayal, remorse versus responsibility, Shizu’s exclusion from the confession, competing obligations to father and mentor, and the end of the Meiji era as a historical language for private guilt.
